assertions.subject: RTL9210B-CG package escape
assertions.assertion: Qualification basis is QFN-68, 8 x 8 mm, 0.4-mm pitch and exposed pad 69; production package/land-pattern confirmation remains open.
assertions.project_implication: Use only frozen qualification footprint and local manufacturing audit.

assertions.subject: RTL9210B-CG placement
assertions.assertion: U1 is frozen on F.Cu at anchor (18,8), rotation 0 degrees, pin 1 southwest for Path-B qualification.
assertions.project_implication: Routing implements baseline; reopening requires structural contradiction evidence.

assertions.subject: MIC2545A support switch
assertions.assertion: EN must be owned, duplicated IN pins tied, duplicated OUT pins tied, ILIM resistor to GND, and nearby IN bypass used.
assertions.project_implication: Promotion remains open until native connectivity and power/inrush checks close.

assertions.subject: USB3 physical routing
assertions.assertion: Controlled return paths and managed transitions are required; connector-side protection topology follows selected device guidance.
assertions.project_implication: Consult subsystem brief before escape or protection changes.

assertions.subject: RTL9210B production application circuit
assertions.assertion: Community package/support evidence exists, but an authorized manufacturer application circuit has not been retained.
assertions.project_implication: Do not use community precedent to close reset, clock, SPI, ISOLATEB sequencing, or SSD-power gates.
